row:
We are a 501c3 nonprofit founded in 2017 in Oakville, WA. We take in unwanted animals, give them care and love, and prepare them for their future adoptive homes. Those that are not adoptable will live out their lives at the sanctuary. 

A place where animals aren't just something, they're everything!
